text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear position in first paragraph","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states its claim about driverless cars early and directly, so the reader immediately knows the writer’s stance."},{"evidence":"Three body paragraphs on energy, safety, convenience","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups its reasons into distinct sections that make the argument easy to follow."},{"evidence":"Half the fuel; CO2; pollution and climate effects","quality":"evidence use","description":"The essay develops its points with multiple supporting details from the article and extends them into explanation."},{"evidence":"“Thus” and “Safety is a large concern...”; “The convenience... combined with the safety features”","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay more often explains how the evidence supports the claim instead of only stating opinions."},{"evidence":"“There are simply too many advantages to be ignored” and closing restatement","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends by summarizing its case and reinforcing the overall argument in a clear final paragraph."}]}
